events.result:
Batch 3 migrated, 40 records (120 migrated so far).
Validation note: the old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes. The new CRM
assumed every number was domestic and saved it with a +1 prefix. 31 of the 120
records migrated so far belong to overseas customers, so their phone numbers in the
new CRM are wrong. Records from batches 4 to 10 will have the same problem.
New CRM activity: 14 sales users have opened customer records in the last 24 hours.

args.body: Migration paused after batches 1–3 (120 of 400 records). Validation reports that the new CRM added +1 to every phone number: 31 overseas customer records now have incorrect numbers. The tool did not provide affected customer IDs or correct numbers. Batches 4–10 (280 records) would have the same problem, so I have not started them. Fourteen sales users opened customer records in the last 24 hours and may have relied on incorrect numbers; specific users and records were not supplied. Please arrange identification of the 31 affected records and their verified country codes/numbers, authorize correction of those live records, and have the CRM migration owner fix country-code handling before migration resumes. Please also alert affected sales users through the appropriate internal channel.

events.text:
Migration paused at **120/400 records**: validation found **31 incorrect overseas phone numbers** and confirmed remaining batches would have the same issue.

Morgan Lee has been notified immediately because sales users may already be relying on affected records. Remaining batches are on hold pending correction.
